function.name: get_day_calendar_events
function.description: Return the events for a specific date. If a user name is provided, return events for that user; otherwise, return events for all users.

date.description: Specify the day to retrieve events for. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

name.description: Specify the user to retrieve events for. If omitted, return events for all users.

function.name: create_calendar_event
function.description: Create a new event in a user's calendar with the specified title and date.

date.description: Specify the day to add the event. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

start_time.description: Specify the start time of the event. Format: HH:MM.

end_time.description: Specify the end time of the event. Format: HH:MM.

name.description: Specify the user to add the event for.

event.description: Specify the title of the event to create.

attendees.description: List the email addresses of attendees.

function.name: cancel_calendar_event
function.description: Cancel an existing event from a user's calendar using the event title and date.

date.description: Specify the day to cancel the event. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

name.description: Specify the user to cancel the event for.

event.description: Specify the title of the event to cancel.

function.name: reschedule_calendar_event
function.description: Reschedule an existing event in a user's calendar to a new date using the event title.

name.description: Specify the user to reschedule the event for.

event.description: Specify the title of the event to reschedule.

reschedule_date.description: Specify the new date for the event.
